Priya: Heads up — we need alignment on SI co-sell custody & lead routing for the Marketplace launch next month. Can we lock rules today? cc @Eli @Ben @Samira
Ben: Quick q: will SI claims still auto-assign to AE pools or go to partner team first?
Eli: Partner team triages -> AE pool only after validation. Prefer 'partner-first' for Marketplace.
Samira: Agree. Also need account mapping to avoid overlap with Dedicated and Private deals.
Priya: Proposed rules: 1) SI owns inbound leads for named accounts. 2) If lead originates from Marketplace -> partner triage within 12h. 3) If partner can't verify within 48h, fallback to AE. Thoughts?
Ben: Works. Need a field in lead object `si_claimed_by` and `claim_ts` for audit.
Eli: I'll add to intake schema. Example mapping snippet for the ops team:
```
account_id,account_name,region,owner_si,ae_owner,mapping_rule
ACCT-1234,Acme Corp,NA,SI-Atlas,AE-Kate,marketplace_priority
ACCT-5678,BetaInc,EU,SI-Atlas,AE-Jon,reserved_dedcap
```
Samira: We also need ROE: no direct outreach by AE without partner OK for 7 days post-claim. Also define escalation path if partner unresponsive.
Priya: Add SLA summary for playbook: partner triage 12h, verification 48h, escalation after 72h. Can we embed this in the intake form and routing rules?
Ben: :thumbsup: I'll update the ops doc and add a workflow in the routing service. Will include sample SQS topic + lambda mapping.
Eli: Notes for schema change: add `si_claimed_by` (string), `claim_ts` (iso8601), `claim_source` (marketplace|direct|referral), `fallback_policy` (string). Backwards compatible.
AtlasBot: Reminder: marketplace integration dry-run scheduled 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC — please ensure partner mappings are in staging by 2026-03-29.
Eli: Assigning follow-ups: Ben -> ops doc update + routing workflow, Eli -> intake schema + PR, Samira -> conflict matrix for account overlaps. I'll draft a canary fallback rule for early traffic.
Priya: Thanks — calendar invite for 11:00 AM today (15m) sent. We’ll finalize gating and ownership there.
Ben: On it.
Samira: See you.
